intent_snapshot.goal: Close the remaining Issue #177 acceptance item on verdict transfer integrity: the reviewer's own verdict bytes become the primary submission channel (submit_review with an omitted verdict applies the host-observed receipt), the Pi host gains the Claude-equivalent receipt observation, and the review attestation binds a reviewer_verdict_sha256 digest so post-hoc audit can prove the persisted verdict equals what the reviewer produced. Decision record: docs/adr/0017-receipt-bound-review-verdict-submission.md (merged before this task).

acceptance.assertion: Per ADR 0017: submit_review with an omitted verdict applies the host-observed reviewer receipt bytes as the review verdict after the existing parseAssuranceVerdict snapshot validation, on both hosts, with the settlement actor unchanged; a provided verdict keeps the existing fingerprint comparison and blocked recovery byte for byte, with recovery_action wording naming the no-verdict resubmission first; the host-neutral mediation is shared by both host adapters (extracted from the Claude adapter) and the coordinator's verdict-source resolution stays in the adapters. Positive: no-verdict submission on a correlated receipt settles a pass/rework review on each host. Negative: a fingerprint mismatch still blocks without writing authority; an omitted verdict with no observed receipt fails closed without releasing the reservation.

Per ADR 0017: the Pi extension observes the generic tool_call event for an Agent dispatch whose prompt digest matches the reserved prompt (promptDigest), stores the paired tool_result content bytes on that review reservation, and resolves a submit_review without a verdict from those bytes; the receipt lives in process memory with the same lifetime as the reservation (no new persisted surface, no FileHookEventLog on Pi); a provided-verdict submission with no recorded receipt, or a second distinct result for one reservation, fails closed retaining the reservation with recovery guidance. Positive: a recorded Agent result settles a review through the no-verdict path. Negative: an unobserved or rewritten dispatch cannot submit a provided verdict.

Per ADR 0017: TaskApprovalV2 gains optional reviewer_verdict_sha256 (sha256:<64 hex>), bound from the observed receipt bytes at submission, legal only on review attestations; the strict parser emits it only when present so legacy records keep byte-roundtrip and canonical hash stability, the reducer rejects it on non-review approvals, and verdict_authority threads it from the host adapter without the coordinator resolving verdict sources. Positive: a review attestation written with the digest parses back byte-identical and fails on a non-sha256 value. Negative: a qa attestation carrying the field is rejected; records without it are unchanged. Recovery safety, from the reproduced invalid Spec-binding incident: intent revision rejects ambiguous or incomplete Spec bindings before authority writes; an existing invalid active binding exposes only revision recovery and is corrected through the existing native breaking gate while retaining run identity, git_base_head, and append-only authority history. Cancellation retains exact prior authority and sidecar bytes.

Per ADR 0017: docs/reference/subagent-dispatch-protocol.md retires the trusts-the-Parent sentence and states the receipt-bound submission on both hosts; the generated Claude reviewer definition (plugins/immune-brain/agents/immune-brain-reviewer.md) and any host packaging surface stay in sync with the new submit_review shape; dist/claude/mcp-server.mjs is regenerated from the changed runtime modules and matches a fresh build. Negative: no prompt file outside the reviewer definition changes the reserved review prompt contract.

attestations.summary: 已核验不可变 revision、单一 parent、tree、manifest digest 和全部 29 个文件的 diff；双宿主 receipt-bound 提交、冲突保护、digest 持久化与 Spec-binding 恢复未发现阻断问题，接受内嵌 Kernel QA 通过证据。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts:110-115：同一 reservation 收到第二份不同结果时，observeReviewResult 静默忽略它，inspectReview 仍返回第一份 receipt。例如先收到 pass、再收到 rework，省略 verdict 的提交仍可写入 pass authority，违反 receipt 唯一性及冲突时 fail-closed 的要求。最小修复是比较后续结果与已存 bytes，发现不同结果时记录不可提交的冲突状态并保留 reservation；通过 extension 的 tool_result seam 验证冲突后两种提交方式均 blocked、无 authority 写入且 reservation 保留。

evidence.trigger: receipt 唯一性 invariant：对一个已匹配 reserved prompt 的 Agent toolCallId，依次观察到有效 pass bytes P 和不同的 rework bytes R，然后调用 submit_review，省略 verdict 或提供 P。第 114 行仅在 result 为 undefined 时赋值，因此 R 被丢弃；inspectReview 返回 P，共享 mediation 将 P 交给 coordinator.submitReview。现有单 receipt 正向测试和 fingerprint mismatch 测试没有覆盖同一 toolCallId 的结果冲突。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/canary_application.ts:264、323-324：新增 Spec-binding guard 没有覆盖 freeze_artifacts，它在执行 guard 前直接进入 freezeArtifacts。对于 scope_hint 只含 docs/specs/archive/x.spec.md 的既有无效 active binding，boundSpecPath 返回 undefined，freeze 仍可把 artifact_state 改为 frozen 并追加 authority history，违反无效 binding 仅允许 revision recovery 的要求。最小修复是在 freezeArtifacts 的任何成功返回或写入前检查当前 binding，并补充 archive-only binding 的拒绝测试，断言 record、claim、sidecar 与 history 保持原样。

evidence.trigger: Spec-binding recovery 隔离 invariant：既有 TaskRecord 的 lifecycle=active、artifact_state=active，intent_snapshot 与 sidecar/hash 一致，但 scope_hint 包含 docs/specs/archive/x.spec.md 且不含 active Spec；调用 freeze_artifacts。inspectSpecBinding 将它判为 binding_incomplete，新增 projection 返回 revise_intent，但 execute 第 264 行提前进入 freezeArtifacts，绕过第 324 行。transitionFor 使用的 boundSpecPath 只枚举 active Specs，因而允许 freeze 写入。现有 tests/breaking-intent-revision-gate.test.ts:264-288 仅以两个 active Specs 验证拒绝，依赖 boundSpecPath 原有的 ambiguity 检查，未覆盖 incomplete binding；这是同一 invariant 的覆盖缺口。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts:123-124：Pi 在已有 reservation 但尚未观察到匹配 dispatch 时返回 release:true；submitMediatedReview 因而调用 abandonReview，删除 reservation、receipt 和 immutable evidence。省略 verdict 且无 receipt 应保留 reservation，RBV-A2 对 provided-verdict 的无 receipt 情况也要求保留。最小修复是让已有 reservation 的无 dispatch/receipt 分支返回 release:false，并调整 tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:734-744 中明确要求释放的错误断言；验证两种提交方式都 blocked、operation_id 和 evidence 保留且无 authority 写入。

evidence.trigger: reservation 保留 invariant：advance_assurance 已返回 Pi review_ready，但没有匹配 reserved prompt 的 tool_call，也没有 receipt；随后调用 submit_review 并省略 verdict。PiReviewHost.inspectReview 第 124 行返回 release:true，共享 mediation 第 68 行调用 abandonReview，coordinator.releaseReviewReservation 删除 reservation 并移除 evidence。新 conformance 测试反而要求下一次 advance 返回不同 operation_id，直接固定了与 RBV-A1 相反的行为；提供 verdict 时也走同一释放分支。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-canary-work.ts:398：空 tool_result 被过滤，导致同一 reservation 的第二个不同结果未触发冲突保护。若先收到有效 pass verdict，再收到 content: [] 或空文本的结果，submit_review 仍可用第一个 receipt 写入 Review authority，违反第二个不同结果必须保留 reservation 并阻断提交的要求。应将空结果也交给 observeReviewResult，并在 extension 的 tool_result seam 增加有效结果后接空结果的负向测试，验证两种提交方式均阻断且 authority 与 evidence 不变。

evidence.trigger: 已保留的 Pi Review reservation 通过匹配 promptDigest 的 Agent tool_call 绑定 toolCallId；该 toolCallId 先收到含有效 pass verdict 的 tool_result，随后收到 content: [] 或 content: [{type: "text", text: ""}] 的第二个 tool_result。imm-canary-work.ts:395-398 将第二个结果转换为空字符串后跳过观察，pi-canary-assurance-progression.ts:114-115 的冲突检测因而只覆盖非空结果；随后无 verdict 提交或提供第一个 verdict 的提交均可继续 settlement。这是 receipt 冲突检测不变量的覆盖缺口：当前非空双结果测试没有覆盖空结果边界。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/kernel/completion.ts:187–205：invalid Spec binding 的新增投影没有关闭非 revision 的 authorization 路径。projectTask 返回 revise_intent 后，assurance_projection 仍将其映射为 authorize_rework，两个 host 的 request_authorization 因此会打开 native gate；确认后 canary_application.ts:325 拒绝旧 binding，恢复无法完成。最小修复是在 invalid binding 时明确禁用普通 authorization readiness，只允许携带有效 next_intent 的 breaking revision recovery，并增加两个 host 在此状态下不打开普通 authorization gate 的测试。

evidence.trigger: Invariant class: invalid Spec binding recovery exposes only revision recovery. An active TaskRecord has two active Spec paths (or only an archived Spec path), no open unresolved_user_decision, and no replan_required finding. The new projectTask branch returns next_obligation='revise_intent'; projectFromRecord then derives authorization.state='authorize_rework'. Calling request_authorization opens a native confirmation for authorize_rework, but an affirmative response reaches assertValidSpecBinding on the invalid current intent and fails. The delivered fix covers next_obligation and direct breaking-revision recovery, but does not cover the authorization readiness derived from that same projection. The unchanged assurance_projection.ts and authorization_operation.ts were inspected because they directly consume the changed projection and own this recovery state transition.

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/assurance/review_mediation.ts:69-72：Pi mediation 在 receipt 缺失时掩盖 coordinator 已保存的 settlement_unknown，返回普通 blocked，丢失 operation_id、原始原因和 reconciliation 指引。tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts:170-187 将原有保护断言改成接受此回归。应在 receipt 检查前保留 settlement_unknown 返回路径，恢复原有断言并覆盖 Review 提交后响应丢失。

evidence.trigger: 不变量类：不确定 settlement 必须保留直到 Kernel reconciliation。QA 或 Review 已跨过 authority commit，随后 hook、projection 或响应失败，coordinator 保存 unknownOperations；Review reservation 已释放，或 QA 尚未建立 reservation。再次通过 Pi submit_review 提供 verdict 时，inspectReview 返回 ok:false，mediation 提前返回 blocked，绕过 submitReviewOnce:1212-1213 的 settlement_unknown 分支。receipt 绑定修复只覆盖活跃 reservation，未覆盖此 settlement 状态。

findings.summary: tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts:1504-1533：约定 extension event seam 缺少省略 verdict 的成功验证。extension 成功测试均提供 verdict，省略 verdict 的 extension 测试只覆盖 conflicting result；dual-host 成功测试直接调用 PiReviewHost 和 submitMediated。应通过注册的 tool_call/tool_result handlers 记录有效 receipt，再执行仅含 op:submit_review 的 Tool action，断言 authority、receipt digest 和 reservation 清理。

evidence.trigger: 不变量类：验收必须在约定 seam 上覆盖完整 receipt-bound submission。输入为匹配 reserved prompt 的 Agent tool_call、配对的有效 Agent tool_result，以及省略 verdict 的 imm_kernel_canary submit_review action。RBV-A2 指定 generic tool_call/tool_result extension seam，但 immutable tests 在该 seam 上没有此输入的成功断言；直接调用 PiReviewHost 的测试绕过事件处理与 Tool action 入口。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/assurance/review_mediation.ts:72-83 在 submission 开始时只检查一次 receipt；随后 coordinator.ts:1220、1235 的异步校验期间，即使 Pi 收到同一 reservation 的第二份不同 result 并标记 conflict，仍会在 coordinator.ts:1248-1258 释放 reservation 并写入首次 verdict 的 authority。应在释放 reservation、进入 authority settlement 前，通过 adapter 提供的校验重新确认 receipt 未冲突，并覆盖该交错顺序。

evidence.trigger: 不变量类：receipt 在 authority commit 前必须持续有效。先观察匹配 reserved prompt 的 Agent dispatch 和有效 result A，调用省略 verdict 或精确转交 A 的 submit_review；在 submitReviewOnce 等待 projectTask 或 ensureReviewRevision 时，再通过同一 toolCallId 观察不同 result B。observeReviewResult 会设置 record.error，但 mediation 已捕获 A，coordinator 不再检查 host receipt，因而仍应用 A。当前 conflicting tool_result 测试只覆盖全部结果先于 submission 到达的顺序，已接受的 conflict 检查未覆盖 submission 校验期间的同类冲突。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/.pi-extension/imm-canary-work.ts:1520–1542,1621–1647：Pi 的失败转换丢弃 receipt mediation 返回的 recovery_action；fingerprint mismatch 最终只返回 next_action="run_review"，未传达验收要求的“省略 verdict 重提交”恢复步骤。最小修复是在 nextActionForAssuranceResult 中采用 mediation 的 recovery_action，并通过真实注册 Tool 的失败结果测试断言该指导完整保留。

evidence.trigger: 恢复指导必须贯穿整个 host 返回链的不变量存在覆盖缺口：Pi reservation 已关联有效 reviewer receipt，Parent 提交同一 snapshot 的有效 verdict，但修改 approval.summary。submitMediatedReview 在 review_mediation.ts:102–103 返回 blocked 和以“Resubmit without a verdict”开头的 recovery_action；imm-canary-work.ts:1520–1542 忽略该字段，回退到 taskState.next_obligation（run_review），随后 :1621–1647 构造 ToolFailure 时仅保留 diagnostics、environment_failure、recovery 和 recovery_error，彻底移除 recovery_action。已有 tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:749–761 仅验证内部 mediation 的 mismatch 与重提交，tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts:1461–1494 仅验证冲突结果的阻断及 reservation 保留，均未覆盖最终 Tool 返回的恢复指导。

findings.summary: Review exhausted its 5-round rework budget; a durable replan is required.

plugins/immune-brain/runtime/assurance/coordinator.ts:1250-1251: 提交等待期间发生 receipt 冲突时，返回 blocked 并保留 reservation，却丢失 RBV-A2 要求的 recovery guidance。将 validateReceipt 失败结果在共享 mediation 中附上明确 recovery_action，并补充现有交错测试对最终 Tool next_action 的断言。

evidence.trigger: receipt-conflict recovery invariant：已记录有效 Agent result，随后调用 submit_review（省略或提供 verdict）；在 submitReviewOnce 等待 projectTask 或 ensureReviewRevision 时，同一 toolCallId 收到第二份不同结果。validateReceipt 返回 conflicting result bytes，coordinator 直接返回只有 state/reason 的 blocked。正常 run_review projection 的 authorization.state 为 none、且没有其他 findings 时，withRecovery 不生成 recovery；Pi 最终 next_action 回落为 run_review，而不是保留 reservation 所需的明确恢复指引。tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts:33-52 覆盖该交错的阻断与 reservation 保留，但未覆盖 guidance，因而已有冲突防护未闭合这个 invariant 的恢复部分。

findings.summary: docs/reference/subagent-dispatch-protocol.md:121-123: 同一文档仍声明 lifecycle event matching 不属于 local authority contract，与新增 receipt-bound 提交规则及 Pi 实现冲突；同步更新这段及 dist 镜像，说明提交依赖 reserved Agent dispatch/result 的关联。

evidence.trigger: Parent 按 Model Selection 段选择不产生已关联 Agent tool_call/tool_result 的 compatible foreground adapter，并依照该段直接提交 structured verdict；Pi inspectReview 将其阻断为未观察到 reserved Agent。文档后面的新增规则要求 receipt，但前面的明确豁免仍保留，造成执行指引相互矛盾。

findings.summary: Review exhausted its 5-round rework budget; a durable replan is required.

tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:715：省略 verdict 的双宿主测试仅覆盖 pass，缺少 RBV-A1 明确要求的 Review rework settlement。补充两宿主的 correlated rework receipt，验证返回 rework、保留 finding evidence、释放 reservation，且不执行 completion。

evidence.trigger: 有效 correlated reviewer receipt 的 decision 为 rework，包含 blocking finding 及 trigger、caller_chain、violated，Parent 调用 submit_review 时省略 verdict。现有双宿主测试只使用 passVerdict；tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts:210 的 rework 用例属于 QA，并不经过新增 receipt-bound Review 路径。Kernel outcomes 的通过结果未证明这一明确验收分支。

findings.summary: tests/pi-canary-work-extension.test.ts:1499：通用 tool_call/tool_result seam 的测试未覆盖改写 reserved prompt 后提交 provided verdict 的拒绝路径。补充该事件级负例，验证即使结果携带有效 snapshot verdict，也不会写 authority，并保留 reservation 与 evidence。

evidence.trigger: 先取得 review_ready.agent_params，再通过扩展注册的 tool_call handler 派发 prompt 被追加或改写的 Agent；通过 tool_result handler 返回该 snapshot 的有效 verdict，随后调用 submit_review 并提供该 verdict。现有事件级测试始终原样派发 agent_params；tests/dual-host-assurance-conformance.test.ts:734 的未观察 dispatch 用例直接调用 progression，未验证 RBV-A2 指定的 generic event seam 对 rewritten dispatch 的拒绝。
